meaning:
ζεῦγος, -εος (-ους), τό
(ζεύγνυμι, to yoke), [in LXX chiefly for צֶמֶד, Jdg.19:3, al. ;]
1. a yoke of beasts: Luk.14:19.
2. a pair of any­thing, Luk.2:24 (LXX).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, “A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.”
